project.name: JOSESwift
project.description: A modular and extensible framework for the JOSE standards JWS, JWE, and JWK written in Swift

nodes.name: AlgorithmExtensions.swift
nodes.summary: Extension methods on ContentEncryptionAlgorithm, SignatureAlgorithm, and KeyManagementAlgorithm enums providing key length validation, HMAC algorithm mapping, and derived key length computation.

nodes.name: Algorithms.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the core cryptographic algorithm enums for JOSE: SignatureAlgorithm, KeyManagementAlgorithm, ContentEncryptionAlgorithm, HMACAlgorithm, JWKThumbprintAlgorithm, and CompressionAlgorithm, along with computed properties for key sizes and tag lengths.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Swift enums with raw String values mapped to JOSE standard algorithm identifiers (RFC 7518). Computed properties on enum cases provide algorithm-specific parameters like keyBitSize and tagLength.

nodes.name: ASN1DEREncoding.swift
nodes.summary: Provides ASN.1 DER encoding utilities by extending Array<UInt8> with a TLV triplet encoder and a private length field helper for serializing cryptographic data structures.

nodes.name: ASN1DERParsing.swift
nodes.summary: Implements ASN.1 DER parsing by extending Array<UInt8> with methods to read, skip, and extract TLV triplets, plus freestanding helpers for tag, length field, and value field parsing.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses internal enums for ASN1Type and TLVTriplet to model the DER transfer syntax. Private helper functions use inout pointer advancement for efficient sequential parsing.

nodes.name: DataConvertible.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the DataConvertible protocol that bridges Data and typed JOSE components, requiring a failable initializer from Data and a method to convert back to Data.

nodes.name: DataExtensions.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data with base64url encoding/decoding, byte length octet hex conversion, constant-time comparison for cryptographic safety, and conformance to DataConvertible.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes timingSafeCompare using timingsafe_bcmp for constant-time comparison of secret values like MACs, preventing timing side-channel attacks.

nodes.name: Deserializer.swift
nodes.summary: Provides the JOSEDeserializer for parsing compact JOSE serializations by splitting on dots, base64url-decoding each component, and delegating to the CompactDeserializer protocol. Also defines component index constants for JWS and JWE structures.

nodes.name: JOSEHeader.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the JOSEHeader protocol and CommonHeaderParameterSpace protocol for JWS/JWE header parameters, with default implementations for parameter get/set/remove and DataConvertible conformance through JSON serialization.

nodes.name: JOSESwiftError.swift
nodes.summary: Central error enum for the JOSESwift framework covering signing, verification, encryption, decryption, data encoding, RSA/EC coding, compression, thumbprint, and header parameter errors.

nodes.name: Payload.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the Payload struct as a DataConvertible wrapper around raw Data, with compression support via CompressorFactory.

nodes.name: Serializer.swift
nodes.summary: Provides the JOSESerializer for compact JOSE serialization by collecting DataConvertible components, base64url-encoding each, and joining with dots.

nodes.name: AES.swift
nodes.summary: Implements AES-CBC encryption/decryption and AES key wrap/unwrap using CommonCrypto, with support for multiple key sizes and content encryption algorithms. Internal ccAESCBCCrypt and ccAESKeyWrap/ccAESKeyUnwrap helpers handle the low-level CommonCrypto operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CommonCrypto's CCCrypt for CBC mode and CCSymmetricKeyWrap/Unwrap for RFC 3394 key wrapping. Unsafe byte pointer manipulation is required for the C API interop.

nodes.name: AESGCM.swift
nodes.summary: Implements AES-GCM encryption and decryption using Apple's CryptoKit, providing authenticated encryption with additional authenticated data support.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CryptoKit (AES.GCM.SealedBox) instead of CommonCrypto, providing a higher-level Swift API for authenticated encryption.

nodes.name: EC.swift
nodes.summary: Implements elliptic curve cryptographic operations including ECDSA sign/verify with ASN.1-to-raw signature conversion, ECDH key agreement encryption/decryption context creation, ephemeral key pair generation, and curve type detection from SecKey attributes.
nodes.languageNotes: Converts between ASN.1 DER-encoded signatures (Apple Security framework format) and raw R||S format (JWS standard) using internal Asn1IntegerConversion. Supports P-256, P-384, and P-521 curves.

nodes.name: ECDHKeyAgreement.swift
nodes.summary: Implements ECDH key agreement with Concat KDF (RFC 7518 Section 4.6.2), including shared secret derivation via SecKeyCopyKeyExchangeResult, bit-length truncation, and a Hash enum providing SHA-256/384/512 digest and HMAC operations via CommonCrypto.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Concat KDF from NIST SP 800-56A as required by RFC 7518 for ECDH-ES key agreement. The Hash enum encapsulates CommonCrypto digest and HMAC functions.

nodes.name: HMAC.swift
nodes.summary: Implements HMAC calculation using CommonCrypto's CCHmac for SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 algorithms, with HMACAlgorithm extensions mapping to CommonCrypto algorithm constants.

nodes.name: PBES2.swift
nodes.summary: Implements PBES2 (Password-Based Encryption Scheme 2) key derivation using PBKDF2 via CommonCrypto's CCKeyDerivationPBKDF, deriving AES key-wrapping keys from passwords for JWE password-based encryption.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CommonCrypto's CCKeyDerivationPBKDF with kCCPBKDF2 algorithm for PBES2 key derivation as specified in RFC 7518 Section 4.8.

nodes.name: SecureRandom.swift
nodes.summary: Provides cryptographically secure random byte generation using Security framework's SecRandomCopyBytes, used for generating IVs, keys, and salt values throughout the framework.

nodes.name: RSA.swift
nodes.summary: Implements RSA cryptographic operations including signing, verification, encryption, and decryption using Apple's Security framework SecKey APIs, with support for PKCS1-v1_5, OAEP, and PSS padding schemes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SecKeyCreateSignature/SecKeyVerifySignature for signing and SecKeyCreateEncryptedData/SecKeyCreateDecryptedData for encryption, mapping JOSE algorithms to SecKeyAlgorithm constants.

nodes.name: Thumbprint.swift
nodes.summary: Computes JWK Thumbprint hashes using SHA-256 via CommonCrypto, returning the result as a base64url-encoded string for JWK identification per RFC 7638.

nodes.name: deserialize
nodes.summary: Deserializes a compact JOSE serialization string by splitting on dots, validating component count, base64url-decoding each component, and constructing the target type via the CompactDeserializer protocol.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.summary: Serializes a CompactSerializable object into a compact JOSE serialization string by collecting components, base64url-encoding each, and joining with dots.

nodes.name: nextTLVTriplet
nodes.summary: Parses a TLV (tag, length, value) triplet from the front of a DER-encoded byte array, advancing through tag, length field, and value field sequentially.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts plaintext using AES-CBC with the specified content encryption algorithm, validating key length before delegating to the CommonCrypto CCCrypt function.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts AES-CBC ciphertext using the specified content encryption algorithm and symmetric key, validating key length before delegating to CommonCrypto.

nodes.name: wrap
nodes.summary: Wraps a raw key using AES Key Wrap (RFC 3394) with the specified key encryption key and key management algorithm.

nodes.name: unwrap
nodes.summary: Unwraps an AES-wrapped key using the specified key encryption key and key management algorithm.

nodes.name: ccAESCBCCrypt
nodes.summary: Low-level AES-CBC encryption/decryption using CommonCrypto's CCCrypt with unsafe byte pointer manipulation for buffer management.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts plaintext using AES-GCM via CryptoKit, returning a ContentEncryptionContext with ciphertext, authentication tag, and initialization vector.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts AES-GCM ciphertext via CryptoKit, verifying the authentication tag against additional authenticated data.

nodes.name: sign
nodes.summary: Signs data using ECDSA with the specified algorithm and private key, then converts the ASN.1 DER signature to raw R||S format for JWS compatibility.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Verifies an ECDSA signature by converting from raw R||S format to ASN.1 DER and delegating to SecKeyVerifySignature.

nodes.name: encryptionContextFor
nodes.summary: Creates an ECDH encryption context by generating an ephemeral key pair, performing key agreement, optionally wrapping the content encryption key, and updating the JWE header with the ephemeral public key.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts an ECDH-encrypted key by performing key agreement with the ephemeral public key from the JWE header and optionally unwrapping the content encryption key.

nodes.name: generateEphemeralSecKeyPair
nodes.summary: Generates an ephemeral EC key pair using SecKeyCreateRandomKey, returning the private SecKey and public key as an ECPublicKey JWK for inclusion in the JWE header.

nodes.name: keyAgreementCompute
nodes.summary: Performs ECDH key agreement computation by deriving shared secret bits and applying the Concat KDF per RFC 7518 Section 4.6.2 to produce the key encryption key.

nodes.name: ecdhDeriveBits
nodes.summary: Derives shared secret bits from an ECDH key exchange using SecKeyCopyKeyExchangeResult, with optional bit-length truncation.

nodes.name: concatKDF
nodes.summary: Implements the Concatenation KDF from NIST SP 800-56A, iteratively hashing the shared secret with derivation parameters to produce the keying material.

nodes.name: calculate
nodes.summary: Calculates an HMAC for input data using the specified key and algorithm via CommonCrypto's CCHmac function.

nodes.name: deriveWrappingKey
nodes.summary: Derives an AES key-wrapping key from a password using PBKDF2 with the specified algorithm, salt, and iteration count via CommonCrypto's CCKeyDerivationPBKDF.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes of the specified count using SecRandomCopyBytes.

nodes.name: sign
nodes.summary: Signs data using RSA with the specified algorithm and private key via SecKeyCreateSignature.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Verifies an RSA signature against input data using SecKeyVerifySignature with the specified algorithm and public key.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts plaintext using RSA with the specified algorithm and public key via SecKeyCreateEncryptedData, with plaintext length validation.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts RSA ciphertext using the specified algorithm and private key via SecKeyCreateDecryptedData, with ciphertext length validation.

nodes.name: calculate
nodes.summary: Computes a SHA hash thumbprint of input data, returning the result as a base64url-encoded string for JWK identification.

nodes.name: timingSafeCompare
nodes.summary: Performs constant-time comparison of Data objects using timingsafe_bcmp to prevent timing side-channel attacks on cryptographic values.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads and returns the value of a specified ASN.1 type from the front of a DER-encoded byte array.

nodes.name: skip
nodes.summary: Skips the specified ASN.1 type at the front of a DER-encoded byte array and returns the remaining bytes.

nodes.name: Compressor.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the CompressorProtocol interface and provides a CompressorFactory that selects the appropriate compression implementation (DEFLATE or none) for JWE payload compression.

nodes.name: makeCompressor
nodes.summary: Factory method that returns the appropriate CompressorProtocol implementation based on the given CompressionAlgorithm, defaulting to NoneCompressor.

nodes.name: DeflateWrapper.swift
nodes.summary: Implements DEFLATE compression and decompression using Apple's Compression framework for JWE payload handling, with a low-level streaming compression wrapper.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Swift's UnsafeMutablePointer and compression_stream API for streaming zlib compression, a low-level pattern requiring manual memory management with defer-based cleanup.

nodes.name: compress
nodes.summary: Compresses data using zlib DEFLATE encoding via Apple's Compression framework with unsafe byte pointer operations.

nodes.name: decompress
nodes.summary: Decompresses zlib DEFLATE data back to its original form via Apple's Compression framework streaming decode.

nodes.name: perform
nodes.summary: Private low-level streaming compression/decompression engine using compression_stream_process with manual buffer management and dealloc guard.

nodes.name: ContentEncryption.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the ContentEncrypter and ContentDecrypter protocols along with encryption/decryption context types, and provides factory methods to create algorithm-specific encrypter/decrypter instances.

nodes.name: makeContentEncrypter
nodes.summary: Factory method returning a ContentEncrypter implementation based on the content encryption algorithm (AES-CBC or AES-GCM).

nodes.name: makeContentDecrypter
nodes.summary: Factory method returning a ContentDecrypter implementation based on the content encryption algorithm (AES-CBC or AES-GCM).

nodes.name: AESCBCEncryption.swift
nodes.summary: Implements AES-CBC content encryption with HMAC authentication for JWE, supporting A128CBCHS256, A192CBCHS384, and A256CBCHS512 algorithms with key splitting and authentication tag truncation.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements AES-CBC with HMAC per RFC 7518, splitting the content encryption key into HMAC and encryption halves, and truncating the HMAC output to half its length for the authentication tag.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts plaintext using AES-CBC with HMAC-based authentication, concatenating AAD, IV, ciphertext, and AL for the HMAC calculation.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts AES-CBC ciphertext by first verifying the HMAC authentication tag with timing-safe comparison, then decrypting with the symmetric key.

nodes.name: retrieveKeys
nodes.summary: Splits the content encryption key into HMAC and AES encryption key halves based on the algorithm's expected key lengths.

nodes.name: AESGCMEncryption.swift
nodes.summary: Implements AES-GCM content encryption and decryption for JWE, supporting A128GCM, A192GCM, and A256GCM algorithms with built-in authenticated encryption.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts the payload using AES-GCM with key length validation, generating a random IV and computing base64URL-encoded additional authenticated data from the header.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts AES-GCM ciphertext with key length validation, passing the authentication tag and additional authenticated data to the underlying AESGCM implementation.

nodes.name: Decrypter.swift
nodes.summary: Provides the Decrypter struct for JWE decryption, delegating key management and content decryption to pluggable implementations with algorithm mismatch validation.

nodes.name: decrypt
nodes.summary: Decrypts a JWE by validating header algorithms, recovering the content encryption key via key management, and delegating to the content decrypter.

nodes.name: Encrypter.swift
nodes.summary: Provides the Encrypter struct for JWE encryption, combining key management and content encryption into a single encryption operation with algorithm mismatch guards.

nodes.name: encrypt
nodes.summary: Encrypts a JWE payload by determining the content encryption key via key management, then delegating content encryption with the resulting key and updated header.

nodes.name: JWE.swift
nodes.summary: Core JWE (JSON Web Encryption) implementation per RFC 7516, supporting compact serialization, deserialization, encryption from header/payload, and decryption with optional compression.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements both CompactSerializable and CompactDeserializable protocols for JWE compact serialization, with the five-part structure (header, encryptedKey, IV, ciphertext, authTag).

nodes.name: init(header:payload:encrypter:)
nodes.summary: Initializes a JWE by compressing the payload per the header's compression algorithm and encrypting via the provided Encrypter.

nodes.name: decrypt(using:)
nodes.summary: Decrypts the JWE ciphertext using the provided Decrypter, then decompresses the result according to the header's compression algorithm.

nodes.name: JWEHeader.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the JWEHeader struct conforming to JOSEHeader and CommonHeaderParameterSpace, providing typed access to all JWE-specific and common header parameters including key management, encryption, compression, ECDH agreement, and PBES2 derivation parameters.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Swift property observers (didSet) on the parameters dictionary to keep headerData in sync, and force_cast/force_try with documented safety justifications for required parameters validated at init time.

nodes.name: AESKeyWrappingMode.swift
nodes.summary: Implements AES key wrapping (A128KW, A192KW, A256KW) for JWE key management, encrypting the content encryption key with a shared symmetric key using AES wrap/unwrap operations.

nodes.name: determineContentEncryptionKey(with:)
nodes.summary: Generates a random content encryption key and wraps it with the shared symmetric key using AES key wrapping for JWE encryption.

nodes.name: determineContentEncryptionKey(from:with:)
nodes.summary: Unwraps the encrypted key using AES key unwrapping and validates that the recovered content encryption key length matches the expected algorithm length.

nodes.name: DirectEncryptionMode.swift
nodes.summary: Implements direct key agreement for JWE where a pre-shared symmetric key is used directly as the content encryption key, with an empty encrypted key in the JWE.

nodes.name: ECKeyEncryption.swift
nodes.summary: Implements ECDH key agreement for JWE encryption and decryption, supporting ECDH-ES and ECDH-ES+A128/192/256KW key management modes with optional agreement party info.

nodes.name: determineContentEncryptionKey(with:)
nodes.summary: Derives the content encryption key via ECDH key agreement with the recipient's public key, returning an updated JWE header with ephemeral public key data.

nodes.name: determineContentEncryptionKey(from:with:)
nodes.summary: Decrypts the encrypted key using ECDH with the recipient's private key, falling back to a random key if decryption fails to mitigate timing attacks.

nodes.name: PBES2KeyEncryptionMode.swift
nodes.summary: Implements PBES2 (Password-Based Encryption Scheme 2) key management for JWE, deriving a wrapping key from a password using salt and iteration count per RFC 7518.

nodes.name: determineContentEncryptionKey(with:)
nodes.summary: Generates a random salt, derives a key wrapping key from the password using PBES2, and wraps the content encryption key with the derived key.

nodes.name: determineContentEncryptionKey(from:with:)
nodes.summary: Recovers the content encryption key by deriving the wrapping key from the password and header parameters (salt, iteration count), then unwrapping the encrypted key.

nodes.name: RSAKeyEncryptionMode.swift
nodes.summary: Implements RSA key encryption for JWE (RSA1_5, RSA-OAEP, RSA-OAEP-256) with separate encryption and decryption modes, including Million Message Attack (MMA) mitigation in decryption.
nodes.languageNotes: The decryption mode generates a random CEK as fallback when RSA decryption fails, mitigating the Bleichenbacher Million Message Attack (RFC 3218 section 2.3.2).

nodes.name: determineContentEncryptionKey(from:with:)
nodes.summary: Decrypts the encrypted key using RSA private key decryption with MMA mitigation, returning a random key on failure to prevent timing attacks.

nodes.name: KeyManagementMode.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the EncryptionKeyManagementMode and DecryptionKeyManagementMode protocols, and provides factory methods on KeyManagementAlgorithm to instantiate the correct key management mode for each algorithm family (RSA, AES-KW, direct, ECDH, PBES2).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a runtime type-checking cast function to safely convert generic key types to algorithm-specific key types, working around Swift's unconditional SecKey downcast behavior.

nodes.name: makeEncryptionKeyManagementMode
nodes.summary: Factory method that creates the appropriate EncryptionKeyManagementMode implementation based on the key management algorithm, with runtime type checking of the encryption key.

nodes.name: makeDecryptionKeyManagementMode
nodes.summary: Factory method that creates the appropriate DecryptionKeyManagementMode implementation based on the key management algorithm, with runtime type checking of the decryption key.

nodes.name: DataECPrivateKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data to conform to ExpressibleAsECPrivateKeyComponents, providing conversion between raw byte data and EC private key components (curve, x, y, d) in uncompressed ANSI X9.63 format.

nodes.name: DataECPublicKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data to conform to ExpressibleAsECPublicKeyComponents, providing conversion between raw byte data and EC public key components (curve, x, y) in uncompressed ANSI X9.63 format.

nodes.name: ECKeyCodable.swift
nodes.summary: Implements Encodable and Decodable conformance for ECPublicKey and ECPrivateKey JWK types, handling serialization of common JWK parameters and EC-specific parameters (crv, x, y, d) to and from JSON.

nodes.name: ECKeyPair.swift
nodes.summary: Provides utilities for generating EC key pairs using Security framework's SecKeyCreateRandomKey, extracting public keys from private keys, and validating key correspondence.

nodes.name: ECKeys.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the core EC JWK types: ECPublicKey and ECPrivateKey structs conforming to the JWK protocol, along with component type aliases and ExpressibleAsECPublicKeyComponents/ExpressibleAsECPrivateKeyComponents protocols for key material conversion.

nodes.name: ECPublicKey
nodes.summary: JWK struct representing an elliptic curve public key with curve type, x/y coordinates, and support for conversion to/from raw key components, JSON decoding, and thumbprint computation.

nodes.name: ECPrivateKey
nodes.summary: JWK struct representing an elliptic curve private key with curve type, x/y coordinates, private key value, and support for conversion to/from raw key components, JSON decoding, and thumbprint computation.

nodes.name: SecKeyECPrivateKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends SecKey to conform to ExpressibleAsECPrivateKeyComponents, bridging between EC private key JWK components and iOS/macOS Security framework SecKey references.

nodes.name: SecKeyECPublicKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends SecKey to conform to ExpressibleAsECPublicKeyComponents, bridging between EC public key JWK components and iOS/macOS Security framework SecKey references.

nodes.name: JWK.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the core JWK protocol that all key types (RSA, EC, symmetric) conform to, specifying requirements for key type, parameters, JSON serialization, and RFC 7638 thumbprint computation.

nodes.name: JWKExtensions.swift
nodes.summary: Provides convenience extensions on the JWK protocol for parameter subscript access and JSON string/data serialization.

nodes.name: JWKParameters.swift
nodes.summary: Defines CodingKey enums for JWK parameters across key types: common JWK parameters (kty, use, kid, etc.), RSA-specific (n, e, d), symmetric key (k), and EC-specific (crv, x, y, d) per RFC 7517 and RFC 7518.

nodes.name: JWKSet.swift
nodes.summary: Implements the JWKSet struct representing a collection of JWK keys, with JSON serialization/deserialization, Collection conformance for iteration, and ExpressibleByArrayLiteral for literal initialization.

nodes.name: JWKSetCodable.swift
nodes.summary: Implements Encodable and Decodable conformance for JWKSet, using a type-discrimination pattern with JWKBase to dispatch decoding to the correct concrete JWK type (EC, RSA, symmetric) based on the kty parameter.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a type-discrimination decoder pattern: JWKBase attempts decoding first, then throws a typed error to signal which concrete JWK type should be decoded next.

nodes.name: DataRSAPublicKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data to conform to ExpressibleAsRSAPublicKeyComponents, converting between raw DER-encoded PKCS#1 data and RSA public key components (modulus, exponent).

nodes.name: RSAKeyCodable.swift
nodes.summary: Implements Encodable and Decodable conformance for RSAPublicKey and RSAPrivateKey JWK types, handling serialization of common JWK parameters and RSA-specific parameters (n, e, d) to and from JSON.

nodes.name: RSAKeys.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the core RSA JWK types: RSAPublicKey and RSAPrivateKey structs conforming to the JWK protocol, along with component type aliases and ExpressibleAsRSAPublicKeyComponents/ExpressibleAsRSAPrivateKeyComponents protocols.

nodes.name: RSAPublicKey
nodes.summary: JWK struct representing an RSA public key with modulus and exponent, supporting conversion to/from raw key components, JSON decoding, and thumbprint computation.

nodes.name: RSAPrivateKey
nodes.summary: JWK struct representing an RSA private key with modulus, exponent, and private exponent, supporting conversion to/from raw key components, JSON decoding, and thumbprint computation.

nodes.name: SecKeyRSAPublicKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends SecKey to conform to ExpressibleAsRSAPublicKeyComponents, bridging between RSA public key JWK components and iOS/macOS Security framework SecKey references.

nodes.name: DataSymmetricKey.swift
nodes.summary: Extends Data to conform to ExpressibleAsSymmetricKeyComponents, providing a trivial identity conversion between Data and symmetric key components.

nodes.name: SymmetricKeyCodable.swift
nodes.summary: Implements Encodable and Decodable conformance for the SymmetricKey JWK type, handling serialization of common JWK parameters and the symmetric key value (k) to and from JSON.

nodes.name: SymmetricKeys.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the core symmetric JWK type: SymmetricKey struct conforming to the JWK protocol, along with the SymmetricKeyComponents type alias and ExpressibleAsSymmetricKeyComponents protocol.

nodes.name: ECSigner.swift
nodes.summary: Internal ECSigner struct conforming to SignerProtocol, delegating EC signature computation to the EC utility class.

nodes.name: ECVerifier.swift
nodes.summary: Internal ECVerifier struct conforming to VerifierProtocol, delegating EC signature verification to the EC utility class.

nodes.name: HMACSigner.swift
nodes.summary: Internal HMACSigner struct conforming to SignerProtocol, computing HMAC signatures using the HMAC utility class.

nodes.name: HMACVerifier.swift
nodes.summary: Internal HMACVerifier struct conforming to VerifierProtocol, verifying HMAC signatures using timing-safe comparison.

nodes.name: RSASigner.swift
nodes.summary: Internal RSASigner struct conforming to SignerProtocol, delegating RSA signature computation to the RSA utility class.

nodes.name: RSAVerifier.swift
nodes.summary: Internal RSAVerifier struct conforming to VerifierProtocol, delegating RSA signature verification to the RSA utility class.

nodes.name: JWS.swift
nodes.summary: Core JWS struct implementing JSON Web Signature creation from header/payload/signer, compact serialization/deserialization, and signature validation using the Verifier abstraction.

nodes.name: JWSHeader.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the JWSHeader struct conforming to JOSEHeader and CommonHeaderParameterSpace, providing typed access to all RFC 7515 registered header parameters (alg, jku, jwk, kid, x5u, x5c, x5t, x5tS256, typ, cty, crit) with getter/setter properties.

nodes.name: Signer.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the SignerProtocol and public Signer struct that dispatches signing to algorithm-specific implementations (ECSigner, RSASigner, HMACSigner) based on the SignatureAlgorithm, with support for custom signer injection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Strategy pattern: Signer delegates to algorithm-specific SignerProtocol implementations selected at init time.

nodes.name: Verifier.swift
nodes.summary: Defines the VerifierProtocol and public Verifier struct that dispatches verification to algorithm-specific implementations (ECVerifier, RSAVerifier, HMACVerifier) based on the SignatureAlgorithm, with support for custom verifier injection.

nodes.name: AESCBCContentDecryptionTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests AES-CBC content decryption for A128CBCHS256, A192CBCHS384, and A256CBCHS512 algorithms using RFC 7518 test vectors, verifying both direct and protocol-based decryption interfaces.

nodes.name: AESCBCContentEncryptionTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests AES-CBC content encryption for A128CBCHS256, A192CBCHS384, and A256CBCHS512 algorithms with RFC 7518 test data, verifying HMAC authentication tags and ciphertext via CommonCrypto.

nodes.name: AESGCMEncryptionTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests AES-GCM encryption and decryption for A128GCM, A192GCM, and A256GCM algorithms using RFC 7516 test vectors, including header-payload interface and CryptoKit verification.

nodes.name: AESKeyWrapKeyManagementModeTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests AES key wrap key management mode for A128KW, A192KW, and A256KW algorithms, verifying random CEK generation, encryption, decryption, and error handling for invalid keys and algorithms.

nodes.name: AESKeyWrapTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests AES key wrap and unwrap operations using RFC 3394 test vectors, including error handling for invalid key sizes and verification that GCM algorithms are rejected in CommonCrypto paths.

nodes.name: ASN1DEREncodingTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests ASN1 DER encoding of integers and sequences, verifying correct TLV encoding for short integers, long integers, and sequences with varying element ordering.

nodes.name: ASN1DERParsingTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests ASN1 DER parsing of TLV triplets, integer reading, sequence reading, and type skipping, including error cases for incorrect length fields and value lengths.

nodes.name: CryptoTestCase.swift
nodes.summary: Base test case class providing shared cryptographic test infrastructure including SecKey pair setup, hexadecimal string-to-data conversion, and data-to-hexadecimal conversion helpers.

nodes.name: CryptoTestCase
nodes.summary: Abstract base test case providing SecKey pair creation from raw key data and a setUp hook for key initialization in subclasses.

nodes.name: setupSecKeyPair
nodes.summary: Static helper that creates a SecKey pair (private and public) from raw key data using Security framework attributes.

nodes.name: DataECPrivateKeyTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests EC private key Data conversion, verifying coordinate extraction, curve type identification, component-to-data round-tripping, and rejection of compressed points and invalid data.

nodes.name: DataECPublicKeyTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests EC public key Data conversion, verifying coordinate extraction, curve type identification, component-to-data round-tripping, and rejection of compressed points and invalid octet lengths.

nodes.name: DataExtensionTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests Data extension methods for Base64URL encoding/decoding, byte length as octet hex data, and timing-safe comparison, covering edge cases with padding, underscores, and dashes.

nodes.name: DataRSAPublicKeyTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests RSA public key Data conversion, verifying modulus extraction (leading zero stripping), exponent extraction, and round-trip conversion for 2048-bit and 4096-bit keys.

nodes.name: DirectEncryptionKeyManagementModeTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests the direct encryption key management mode, verifying that the shared symmetric key is returned as the content encryption key and that the encrypted key is empty.

nodes.name: ECAsn1IntegerConversionTests.swift
nodes.summary: Tests EC ASN1 integer conversion between raw and ASN1 formats, covering one-byte, four-byte, and 64-byte integers with various leading bit patterns.

nodes.name: ECCryptoTestCase.swift
nodes.summary: EC cryptography test base class providing pre-generated test key data for P-256, P-384, and P-521 curves, including JWK components, compact serialized JWS test vectors, and SecKey pairs.

nodes.name: ECTestKeyData
nodes.summary: Test data container holding pre-generated EC key pair data including coordinates, private octets, JWS test vectors, and SecKey references for a specific curve.

nodes.name: ECCryptoTestCase
nodes.summary: Base test case for EC tests providing pre-configured P-256, P-384, and P-521 test key data and helper methods for JWS header generation.

nodes.name: ECDHTests.swift

layers.name: Common Layer
layers.description: Shared JOSE framework fundamentals including algorithm type definitions, serialization/deserialization protocols, header abstractions, error types, and data conversion utilities used across all JOSE standards (JWS, JWE, JWK).

layers.name: Crypto Primitives Layer
layers.description: Low-level cryptographic primitive implementations wrapping Apple's CommonCrypto, CryptoKit, and Security framework APIs for AES-CBC, AES-GCM, RSA, ECDSA/ECDH, HMAC, PBES2, secure random generation, and SHA thumbprint computation.

layers.name: JWE Layer
layers.description: JSON Web Encryption (RFC 7516) implementation including the core JWE struct, encrypter/decrypter strategy pattern, header parameter handling, content encryption (AES-CBC-HMAC and AES-GCM), key management modes (RSA, AES-KW, ECDH, PBES2, direct), and DEFLATE compression support.

layers.name: JWS Layer
layers.description: JSON Web Signature (RFC 7515) implementation including the core JWS struct, signer/verifier strategy pattern with algorithm-specific dispatch, header parameter handling, and default crypto implementations for ECDSA, RSA, and HMAC signing and verification.

layers.name: JWK Layer
layers.description: JSON Web Key (RFC 7517) implementation including the core JWK protocol, concrete key types for EC (P-256/384/521), RSA, and symmetric keys, SecKey platform bridging, JSON Codable conformance, JWK Set collection support, and RFC 7638 thumbprint computation.

layers.name: Test Suite
layers.description: Comprehensive XCTest suite covering all JOSE standards with RFC test vectors, shared test infrastructure base classes (CryptoTestCase, ECCryptoTestCase, RSACryptoTestCase, HMACCryptoTestCase), and test data key files for validating cryptographic operations.

layers.name: Infrastructure and Configuration
layers.description: Build system, CI/CD pipeline (CircleCI with fastlane), code quality tooling (SwiftFormat, SwiftLint, SonarQube), Xcode project configuration, package management (SPM, CocoaPods, Gemfile), deployment scripts, and framework support files.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project documentation including the README with installation and usage guides, security policy, contribution guidelines, code of conduct, changelog, and knowledge graph metadata for the code intelligence system.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what JOSESwift is and why it exists. This document covers the three JOSE standards the framework implements -- JWS (signing), JWE (encryption), and JWK (key representation) -- along with supported algorithms, installation options (CocoaPods, Carthage, SPM), and concise usage examples for each standard.

tour.title: Common Algorithms and Types
tour.description: The Common layer defines the shared vocabulary used across the entire framework. Algorithms.swift enumerates every cryptographic algorithm JOSESwift supports -- SignatureAlgorithm, KeyManagementAlgorithm, ContentEncryptionAlgorithm, and more -- each with computed properties for key sizes and tag lengths. AlgorithmExtensions.swift adds validation and mapping logic on top of those enums, such as deriving HMAC algorithm identifiers and computing key lengths for content encryption.

tour.title: Serialization and Data Layer
tour.description: JOSE uses compact serialization (dot-separated base64url segments) for wire format. Serializer.swift and Deserializer.swift handle the encoding and parsing of this format. DataExtensions.swift provides the base64url encoding/decoding and constant-time comparison (timingSafeCompare) that underpins all JOSE operations, while DataConvertible.swift defines the protocol that bridges raw Data with typed JOSE components like headers and payloads.

tour.title: Headers, Payloads, and Errors
tour.description: JOSEHeader.swift defines the protocol shared by JWS and JWE headers, establishing how header parameters (alg, kid, typ, etc.) are stored as a JSON dictionary with typed accessors. Payload.swift wraps raw data with DataConvertible conformance and compression support. JOSESwiftError.swift provides the central error enum used throughout the framework, covering every failure mode from signing failures to decryption errors.

tour.title: Cryptographic Primitives
tour.description: The CryptoPrimitives layer provides the low-level cryptographic operations that JWS and JWE build upon. RSA.swift and EC.swift implement signing, verification, encryption, and decryption using Apple's Security framework and CommonCrypto. AES.swift handles AES-CBC and key wrapping, AESGCM.swift provides authenticated encryption via CryptoKit, and HMAC.swift computes message authentication codes. These primitives isolate all C API interop and unsafe pointer manipulation behind Swift-friendly interfaces.

tour.title: JWS: Signing and Verification
tour.description: The JWS module implements JSON Web Signatures per RFC 7515. JWS.swift is the public entry point -- create a signed token from a header, payload, and signer, then serialize it to compact format. Signer.swift uses the Strategy pattern to dispatch to algorithm-specific implementations: RSASigner, ECSigner, and HMACSigner, each delegating to the corresponding crypto primitive. Verifier.swift mirrors this structure for signature validation. The JWSHeader struct provides typed access to all RFC 7515 header parameters.

tour.title: JWE: Encryption and Decryption
tour.description: The JWE module implements JSON Web Encryption per RFC 7516. JWE.swift is the core struct supporting compact serialization with its five-part structure (header, encrypted key, IV, ciphertext, auth tag). Encryption is split into two pluggable concerns: key management (how the content encryption key is protected) and content encryption (how the payload is encrypted). Encrypter.swift and Decrypter.swift orchestrate these two phases, while JWEHeader.swift provides typed access to JWE-specific parameters.

tour.title: JWE Key Management Modes
tour.description: JWE supports multiple ways to protect the content encryption key, each implemented as a separate mode. RSAKeyEncryptionMode.swift handles RSA-based key wrapping (RSA1_5, RSA-OAEP, RSA-OAEP-256) with built-in Bleichenbacher attack mitigation. ECKeyEncryption.swift implements ECDH key agreement. AESKeyWrappingMode.swift provides symmetric key wrapping, PBES2KeyEncryptionMode.swift derives keys from passwords, and DirectEncryptionMode.swift uses a pre-shared key directly. KeyManagementMode.swift ties them together with factory methods.

tour.title: JWE Content Encryption
tour.description: Content encryption handles the actual payload confidentiality and integrity. AESCBCEncryption.swift implements AES-CBC with HMAC authentication per RFC 7518, splitting the content encryption key into separate HMAC and encryption halves. AESGCMEncryption.swift uses CryptoKit for authenticated AES-GCM encryption. ContentEncryption.swift defines the protocols and factory methods that let Encrypter/Decrypter create the right implementation based on the algorithm.

tour.title: JWK: Key Representation
tour.description: The JWK module implements JSON Web Key representation per RFC 7517. JWK.swift defines the core protocol that all key types conform to, specifying requirements for key type identification, parameter access, JSON serialization, and RFC 7638 thumbprint computation. The module is organized by key family: RSAKeys.swift and ECKeys.swift define the public/private key structs, while corresponding Codable files handle JSON serialization and Data/SecKey bridge files convert between JWK format and Apple's native key types.

tour.title: JWK Sets and Serialization
tour.description: JWKSet.swift represents a collection of JWK keys as defined in RFC 7517, with Collection conformance for iteration and JSON serialization. JWKSetCodable.swift implements the encoding and decoding logic using a type-discrimination pattern: during decoding, the kty (key type) parameter determines which concrete JWK type (RSA, EC, or symmetric) to deserialize. JWKParameters.swift defines the CodingKey enums that map JSON field names to Swift properties across all key types.

tour.title: Build and Distribution
tour.description: Package.swift is the Swift Package Manager manifest defining the library target across Apple platforms (iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS). JOSESwift.podspec provides the CocoaPods distribution configuration. Together these files define how JOSESwift is packaged, versioned, and distributed to consumers. The Package.swift also specifies which source directories are included in the framework target.

tour.title: CI/CD Pipeline and Security Policy
tour.description: The CircleCI pipeline runs on macOS M1 executors, performing dependency installation, testing via fastlane, and linting with SwiftFormat and SwiftLint. The Fastfile orchestrates the full release lifecycle including version bumping, CocoaPods publication, and GitHub release creation. SECURITY.md documents the project's security posture: JOSESwift uses Apple's Security framework and CommonCrypto exclusively, with clear guidance on supported versions and vulnerability reporting.
